name: Project Lyra 2
source: Hibberd, Hein, Eubanks & Kennedy 2022, Project Lyra: a mission to 1I/'Oumuamua without solar Oberth manoeuvre (Acta Astronautica 199, arXiv:2201.04240), Table 2: legs solved as Lambert arcs between JPL Horizons positions on the paper's dates; the deep space manoeuvre placed at 2.2 au to match the paper's speeds. The 'Oumuamua path is JPL Horizons (JPL#16).
